an6.92:1.3: Consummate in view, diṭṭhi-sampanna, is an epithet for a person who has attained stream-entry. According to the Commentary, this means that the stream-enterer cannot intentionally break any of the five precepts or adopt any of the 62 wrong views listed in DN 1. In other words, the stream-enterer has, at most, no more than seven future births before gaining full awakening.
